notes.title: Pre-Update News #1
notes.content:
Wranglers,

A new update for the game is coming down the pipe and will be released this coming week. The update includes some changes that address optimization and gameplay.

There were a few things I did that before this update that weren't necessarily the best practices when it comes to handling texture and model compression. Pretty much all of these things will be fixed with the update and better performance can be expected.

Gameplay is getting a revamp as far as how you engage with it. Prior to the update, stations involuntarily assigned asteroids to the player to retrieve. This specific aspect of gameplay will now be much more voluntary and selective. Additionally, much more gameplay specific information will be visible and available to the player to improve specifically retrieving asteroids, but also additional game modes that are coming.

Speaking of additional game modes. In the last update, I included the foundation for a new game mode in the form of very large stationary asteroids beside stations. Without revealing too much now, a new game mode will be introduce with this update that will focus around those. More info on that will come with the actual update announcement.

There is still a lot that I have planned to be brought into the game in the coming weeks, so you can expect much more content coming soon. More announcements like this will also be made more often to keep everyone up-to-date on development. 

Cheers!

notes.title: Update #1 - Fleshing Out Bones
notes.content:
Fixed and added a couple things. Player can see positioning info on themselves and asteroid to recover. Moon is more visible from Earth. Added very large asteroids for new upcoming task. 

More coming in a few days. Thanks for all the feedback and support so far on the game. Things will only get better.
